audit_items.proof_trace: MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS retention enforcement is missing. The P2P request handler serves all requested data columns without age validation (explicit TODO at L1612). No pruning logic is invoked (prune_data_columns has zero call sites), and no epoch-based filtering exists in the query path.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends DataColumnsByRoot requests for arbitrarily old epochs. Node serves the data without checking current_epoch - sidecar_epoch <= MIN_EPOCHS threshold, violating spec-mandated retention boundaries and potentially causing resource exhaustion or serving stale/invalid data.
